mechanism: Leflunomide is hepatotoxic and can cause liver injury; dronedarone also has hepatotoxic potential and is metabolized hepatically (CYP3A4), increasing risk of accumulation and toxicity with concurrent use.
action: Monitor liver function tests closely (ALT, AST) at baseline and regularly during concurrent therapy; consider alternative antiarrhythmic if possible; ensure appropriate washout if transitioning between agents.
